{{Quote|The clone navy has attempted blockades of neutral systems throughout the provinces&hellip;but Tofen's Raiders ''smash'' them. Many Jedi have tried to stop him&hellip;and failed.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], commenting on Tofen Vane's exploits|<ref name="HotC" />}}
A member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], an '''Aqualish Jedi''' of the [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] race served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The individual had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin. After the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] took the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="HotC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date" /> the Republic established [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] of neutral star systems of the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]] that supplied military aid to the Separatists. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was placed in charge of a blockade of one such [[Unidentified star system (Valahari Provinces)|system]], along with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. Shortly afterward, the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish's]] forces were [[Battle of an unidentified star system (Valahari Provinces)|attacked]] by the Valahari [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]]. The Jedi flew a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] into battle, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Vane. The entire Republic fleet was also destroyed. The Aqualish was one of the dozen Jedi pilots killed by Vane.<ref name="HotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi appeared in the [[The Clone Wars 11|eleventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Brian Koschak]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="HotC" /> on [[December 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-242/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-11----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-2|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #11 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 2}}</ref>
